continuity: Tactics Ogre: Wheel of Fortune, Japanese PSP launch release (11 November 2010)
work_or_witness: Square Enix 2010 PSP release announcement and official product description
description: The young protagonist through whose perspective the PSP game's Valeria conflict is presented; Square Enix states that player choice moves the world and changes the story's development.

roles_and_vocations.note: The official 2010 announcement expressly calls Denim the protagonist; no class, faction, lineage, or party role is inferred.

narrative_archetypes.note: The source says the story is drawn from Denim's viewpoint and player choice changes the world; this does not select or privilege a route.

game_mechanics.note: A game narrative system, not an intrinsic personal power or an alignment node.

canon_status: named protagonist in the selected Japanese PSP Wheel of Fortune witness

supports: The game depicts the story from the perspective of its young protagonist, Denim, and player choices greatly move the world.
The Valeria conflict is presented from the young protagonist Denim's perspective, with developments and conclusions changing according to player choice.

comparison_cautions: This is a separate 2010 PSP edition record. It must not be auto-merged with SRC-128's 2022 Reborn character record, even where a later localization uses a similar name.
